title: Negative: dimensioned sketch of stepped object 6-8 ft long covered with protruding cups
description: Landscape white-on-black negative photostat of a line sketch of an irregular, stepped, propeller-like object dimensioned "6' to 8'" long and "1-1/2' x 2'" high. Its surface is drawn with many small circles, annotated "These are round cups which protrude". The sketch bears struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps and the signature block of a USAF 1st Lt., Intel Officer.
